messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@orionbi.com>, Leah Kim <l.kim@orionbi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Next step: 60-90min ML/Infra deep-dive — scheduling & attendee confirmation

Hi Sanjay / Leah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to hear more about Orion BI's latency targets and the batch inference workloads. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Outcome from discovery: team is interested in a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive that includes ML infra, model serving constraints, and a short ops runbook discussion.
- Goal of the next session: align on architecture, validate perf expectations, and identify any gating security/compliance asks.

Can we lock a 60–90 minute slot within the next two weeks? My initial availability windows (PT):
- Tue Aug 10: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed Aug 11: 10:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 12: 08:30–10:00

Please pick any that work, or propose other windows — and share who from your side should join (ML lead, infra engineer, security). We'll bring the ML infra engineer and a solutions engineer from our side (cc'd Marissa and Mina).

Draft agenda (attached as proposed-agenda.md):
1) 10m recap & success criteria
2) 30–45m architecture + performance assumptions (model family, token rates, batching)
3) 20–30m ops/runbook + rollout options (Dedicated vs Private)
4) 10m open Q&A + next actions

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (high-level notes), proposed-agenda.md (agenda draft) — see Drive link below.

If there are security/compliance people who need to be looped in, we can add a short pre-read covering data retention and KMS options.

Thanks — I’ll open a quick calendar poll once you confirm preferred days so we can get an owner from both sides on the invite.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
